long_biography.plain_text:
Steve Hinchcliff grew up around H+H's Omaha Chevrolet dealership and began with groundskeeping tasks at fourteen. He later worked across store departments, an education he says made customer retention and service as important as the initial sale. When the group acquired premium European marques, he changed service prices and expanded loaner availability to bring those stores closer to H+H's established approach.

The group also broadened through Kia and Chrysler-group franchises, while its Omaha dealerships moved to a larger site. Hinchcliff's son Jeff now runs day-to-day group leadership as president. Steve remains chairman and co-owner, working with Jeff on the group's continuing dealership operations around Omaha.
